root_forward: rootZ per frame: forward travel of the hips baked into the frames
projection: x=144+cos(yaw)*lateral+sin(yaw)*forward; y=worldY+0.18*depth; depth=cos(yaw)*forward-sin(yaw)*lateral. Positive depth is nearer.
planted_feet: right foot fixed through the cut; left foot fixed from landing (slash 4-9, heavy 5-9)

extra_joints.sword_tip: end of the blade (hand_right + 54px along the blade)
extra_joints.shield: centre of the shield on the left forearm
extra_joints.shield_r0: shield rim, 8 points 45deg apart (r0..r7); the face is the plane through them
extra_joints.shield_b0: back rim of the shield, 8 points (thickness 3.5px)
extra_joints.shield_face: a point 6px in front of the face of the shield: nearer than shield = the face is toward the viewer
extra_joints.strap_a: arm strap end (along the left forearm)

slash.label: 通常斬り（踏み込み振り下ろし）
phases: 構え guard: lead (shield) foot forward, wide stance, knees soft, blade up
振り上げ raise: sink onto the rear foot, the blade goes up in front of the face
振りかぶり wind-up: over the head and back, the lead foot lifts, shield thrust out
溜め cocked: wrist bent back, the blade hangs down her back; the rear foot drives her on
着地 lead foot lands - nailed there from now on; the arm comes over, the blade lags behind it
振り下ろし the cut (smear): hips ride forward over the planted foot, arm straight, blade catching up
命中 impact (hit-stop): the wrist snaps - arm and blade one straight line; front knee deep, rear leg long
振り抜き follow-through: elbow fully straight, the blade runs on down and through
残心 hold: arm still straight, stays low for a breath
戻り push back off the front foot (still planted); the blade comes up
引き the lead foot comes back
構え guard again

heavy.label: 破城斬り（跳び上がって叩きつけ）
phases: 構え guard
溜め deep crouch over the rear foot, blade drawn up and back
跳躍 launch: off both feet, blade swept up and cocked
頂点 apex: hangs in the air, bowed back, blade hanging down the back
降下 dive: the arm comes over straight, the blade whipping after it
着地 lead foot lands and stays; the blade still coming
叩きつけ SLAM (hit): wrist snapped, blade driven into the floor
衝撃 shock: holds while the floor cracks
戻り wrench the blade free, push back
引き the lead foot comes back
構え guard
